cause: Loose power cable or faulty power supply
resolution: Check the power connection and test the adapter. Replace the adapter if faulty.

complaint: Computers cannot connect to the internet
cause: Router malfunction or network cable disconnection
resolution: Check router status, reconnect network cables, and restart the router.

cause: Loose wiring or defective LED driver
resolution: Ask a qualified electrician to inspect wiring and replace the faulty driver.

cause: Damaged washer or worn-out tap cartridge
resolution: Replace the washer or cartridge and test the tap for leaks.

complaint: Air conditioner is not cooling properly
cause: Dirty air filter or refrigerant issue
resolution: Clean the air filter and request an HVAC technician to inspect refrigerant levels.
Isolate the power supply and have a qualified electrician replace the socket.

cause: Loose screws or damaged desk joint
resolution: Tighten the screws and replace damaged joints if necessary.
Check cooling fans, clean dust, and have the power supply tested.

complaint: Water is accumulating on the floor
resolution: Restrict access to the wet area and ask maintenance staff to inspect the pipe and drain.

cause: Incorrect input source or loose HDMI cable
resolution: Select the correct input source and reconnect or replace the HDMI cable.

complaint: Campus Wi-Fi connection is very slow
cause: Network congestion or access point issue
resolution: Check access point performance and network traffic.

complaint: Laboratory equipment is not receiving power
cause: Tripped circuit breaker or damaged power connection
resolution: Disconnect equipment and ask a qualified electrician to inspect the circuit.
